chapter_seo_title: The Doomsday Prophecy: A Siege of Twenty Kings in the Death World
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen and allies face over twenty king-level undead in an Ancestral Lord's palace, and discover a prophecy predicting only one will survive. A pivotal chapter in the Death World arc.
og_title: Doomsday Prophecy - World of Immortality Chapter 441
og_description: After thirty years of cultivation, Xiao Chen and his companions are ambushed by twenty king-level death beings and find a book that foretells their doom.
twitter_description: In the depths of the death world, Xiao Chen faces an army of kings and a prophecy of certain death.
